name: outpost
description: outpost: one offline app for a Raspberry Pi, a dashboard (core) and modules behind it

scripts.maps:setup: turbo run build --filter=@outpost/maps-shared && npm run -w @outpost/maps-backend setup
scripts.maps:assets:fetch: turbo run build --filter=@outpost/maps-shared && npm run -w @outpost/maps-backend assets:fetch
scripts.api:gen: npm run -w @outpost/core build && npm run -w @outpost/core openapi && npm run -w @outpost/api-client generate
